cases.name: new-linkedin-technical-case-study
cases.prompt: $sepia-write Write a LinkedIn post for backend engineers explaining how a conventional web API reduced latency from 800 ms to 220 ms by reusing database connections. Do not discuss AI agents.

pass_conditions.text: The post preserves 800 ms, 220 ms, and database connection reuse as the supplied facts.
The response is a LinkedIn post addressed to backend engineers.
Any added arithmetic is transparently calculable from the supplied 800 ms and 220 ms and is not presented as another measurement.

fail_conditions.text: The response states an unsupported mechanism, causal detail, or derived value as a supplied fact.
The response discusses AI-agent reliability or only discusses how to write the post.

cases.name: review-draft-without-edits
cases.prompt: Review this draft for AI-writing patterns without editing it: Our robust solution seamlessly unlocks a transformative developer experience, underscoring our commitment to innovation.

pass_conditions.text: The response identifies concrete AI-writing patterns in the supplied sentence and remains report-only.

fail_conditions.text: The response supplies a rewritten replacement sentence.

cases.name: humanize-existing-paragraph
cases.prompt: Humanize this paragraph while preserving its facts and structure: The release introduces three commands, enabling teams to streamline setup and fostering improved collaboration.

pass_conditions.text: The response minimally revises the paragraph while preserving the three-command fact and original intent.

fail_conditions.text: The response invents facts, materially changes structure or intent, or provides diagnosis without a revision.

cases.name: explicit-humanizer
cases.prompt: $humanizer Revise only the AI-sounding surface language in this paragraph: The tool serves as a pivotal bridge, unlocking seamless collaboration.

pass_conditions.text: The response changes only surface language and preserves the supplied meaning.

fail_conditions.text: The response adds facts, changes structure, or introduces a two-stage defect-list workflow.

cases.name: explore-fragments
cases.prompt: $writing-fragments Help me explore raw notes about debugging a slow API without choosing an outline yet.

pass_conditions.text: Because no output path is supplied, the response asks once where to save fragments and keeps the work in exploration.

fail_conditions.text: The response creates an outline, drafts the article, or claims to write a file.

cases.name: organize-fixed-fragments
cases.prompt: $writing-shape Read raw.md as the fixed pile and shape it into an article; ask me for the article output path before writing.

fixture_files.raw.md:
Connection setup was repeated.
Traces showed queueing.
Pooling reduced median latency.

pass_conditions.text: The response treats raw.md as the fixed input and asks for the article output path before writing.

fail_conditions.text: The response edits raw.md, reopens exploration, or produces the complete article before receiving the output path.

cases.name: write-beat-by-beat
cases.prompt: $writing-beats Read raw.md as the fixed pile and build the article one beat at a time; ask for the article output path and audience prerequisites before writing.

fixture_files.raw.md:
First symptom: slow requests.
Trace evidence: connection queueing.
Failed attempt: retries.
Fix: connection pooling.

pass_conditions.text: The response asks for the output path and audience prerequisites and preserves the grounding-first, one-beat-at-a-time sequence.

fail_conditions.text: The response produces a complete article or skips grounding and user choice.

cases.name: explicit-guanshiyin
cases.prompt: $guanshiyin-writing 请按观、世、音、菩萨四项写一篇关于工程复盘的短文。

pass_conditions.text: 输出按观、世、音、菩萨四维完成短文。

fail_conditions.text: 输出加入未请求的 Sepia 流程说明，或偏离四维方法。

cases.name: job-application-package
cases.prompt: $job-application-packager Prepare a tailored application package and PDF resume, but do not submit anything.

pass_conditions.text: The response requests the missing job posting before producing artifacts and defers resume selection until after job-page intake.

fail_conditions.text: The response invents experience, claims the package is complete, or submits an application.

cases.name: customer-reliability-case
cases.prompt: $customer-facing-agent-reliability-writing $sepia-write Turn verified AI-agent incident evidence into a customer-facing reliability case study.

pass_conditions.text: The response requests the missing verified incident evidence before drafting and preserves the claim boundary.

fail_conditions.text: The response invents incident evidence, enlarges a claim, or drafts the case before receiving evidence.

cases.name: write-python-function
cases.prompt: Write a Python function that parses an ISO 8601 date and raises ValueError for invalid input.

pass_conditions.text: The response remains a development task and may ask one clarifying question about date-only versus datetime scope before implementation.

fail_conditions.text: The response enters a writing-editing workflow or applies a prose skill to the code request.

cases.name: write-database-migration
cases.prompt: Write a PostgreSQL migration that adds a concurrent unique index on users(email).

pass_conditions.text: The response uses CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside a transaction block and disables the migration framework transaction when applicable.

fail_conditions.text: The response wraps CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY in BEGIN/COMMIT or substitutes prose editing for the SQL migration.
